text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The G1 JBC Classic is a mixed-year race
featuring racers in their classic and
senior years. It's
regarded as the top
race on dirt in the regionals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since the first half of the G1 season runs
from October to December, racers in
their classic year are still learning and
improving, leaving them at a slight
disadvantage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's still a significant gap between
Copano Rickey and her seniors, Hokko
Tarumae and Wonder Acute. I'd hoped
our race would be in December, but no
such luck.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's still a bit early for me to
take this on.
The race is being held in the
northeast, and my compass is telling me
it won't be easy.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But I think it's important to experience
the higher
levels. Besides, while it might
seem like I don't
stand a chance...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The qi has not yet swollen to its peak.
We're in
the nineteenth solar term—the
onset of winter.
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae and Acute are conserving their
energy
for December. That's the read I'm
getting.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We should compete for the sake of it,
without
worrying about winning or
losing. Don't you think
so, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it a shot.
Yeah, let's take on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thus, the fledgling Azure Dragon,
traveling from the east of the trigrams,
finally enters the core of
the dazzling
star.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We won't know how well she'll stack up
against
her two formidable opponents
until she gets out
there and tries it.
